lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiFeO₂ (Li₂Fe₂O₄ per unit cell) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with eight atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe centers with four O neighbors in a tetrahedral motif, while Li centers show four O neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The O atoms coordinate to one Fe and one Li. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Fe tetrahedra and corner-sharing between Fe and Li polyhedra.
